An agent is a loop. The model reads the context, decides on the next action, calls a tool, reads the result, and decides again.
The loop stops when the model says it is done, when the budget runs out, or when the user cancels the request.
A tool call is just a structured message. The model writes the name of the tool and the arguments as JSON, and the runtime runs the tool.
The runtime checks the arguments, runs the tool with a timeout, and sends the result back to the model as another message.
Streaming matters because users want to see the first token quickly. The first token latency is what users feel.
Tokens are not words. A token can be a whole word, a piece of a word, a space and a word, or a single byte.
The tokenizer turns text into tokens, the model turns tokens into logits, and the sampler turns logits into the next token.
Temperature controls how random the sampler is. Top p keeps the smallest set of tokens whose probability adds up to p.
When the temperature is zero, the sampler always picks the most likely token, and the output is almost always the same.
The context window is measured in tokens, the price is measured in tokens, and the rate limit is measured in tokens.
智能体是一个循环。模型读取上下文，决定下一步动作，调用工具，读取结果，然后再次决定。
当模型说它完成了，或者预算用完了，或者用户取消了请求，循环就会停止。
工具调用只是一条结构化的消息。模型写出工具的名字和参数，运行时负责执行工具。
运行时检查参数，带着超时执行工具，再把结果作为另一条消息发回给模型。
流式输出很重要，因为用户希望尽快看到第一个字。首字延迟是用户真正能感觉到的。
词元不是词。一个词元可以是一个完整的词，也可以是词的一部分，甚至是一个字节。
分词器把文本变成词元，模型把词元变成分数，采样器把分数变成下一个词元。
温度控制采样有多随机。上下文窗口按词元计算，价格按词元计算，限流也按词元计算。
